service_source.access_method: Read via web retrieval; direct HTML download returned HTTP 403. This is a manual excerpt, not an archived source snapshot.
service_source.interpretation: The career paragraph explicitly gives KU membership in 1912-1925. Expand the abbreviated years to four digits; retain year precision. Do not substitute the 1918 election date, add calendar-day bounds, or import the separate 1928-1933 period in this pilot.

identity_note: Step 3 resolved Hellberg uniquely using FK mandate, name and Karlstad locality. SBL additionally spells out Bernhard (the register's B.) and agrees with the corpus birth and death dates, 1859-10-14 and 1947-07-30. No name table changes are made.
reviewed_by: Codex (agent review)
